intro: Return to Marleth marks the mischievous conclusion to a heated brewing feud in Dun Morogh. Having infiltrated the Kharanos cellar and swapped in a keg of Marleth's fiery Scalder, an adventurer returns to Brewnall Village with a prize barrel of Thunder Ale as indisputable proof.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Having inserted a barrel of Marleth's Scalder in the Kharanos Distillery's cellar, you grab a barrel of Thunder Ale as proof of the deed...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Not bad, friend! Did you have a hard time getting past their guard?
No matter - many thanks, and if you're ever in need of stout with a kick, don't forget the Barleybrews!
